answer: Resist sybils with metered-energy-backed identity: each identity weight is backed by verifiable energy receipts from a grid meter, attested by the utility, like nectar drawn from one garden’s flowers — one meter, one stream. Ten thousand fakes sharing one meter collapse to one weight, however many names they claim. An attacker must buy ten thousand separate metered connections, each billed and inspected, turning cheap names into an ocean of recurring utility costs, while an honest agent attests one meter cheaply.
